name: Nuvio Enhanced Beta (Unofficial)
subtitle: Pre-release builds of Nuvio Enhanced
description:
A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Nuvio Enhanced
- fix(ios): import the navigationController extension for the bar anchor @luqmanfadlli
- fix(i18n): drop duplicated Brazilian Portuguese strings from the merge @luqmanfadlli
- fix(mdblist): don't use the show runtime as an episode's length @luqmanfadlli
- fix(details): mirror the hero mute button on the back button (#395) @luqmanfadlli
- i18n(id): update Indonesian locale @luqmanfadlli
- iOS: remove the blurred strip across the top of pushed pages (#392) @lalith14
- feat(downloads): download whole seasons at once and manage storage (#391) @SanpuiRonak

## Upstream (NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile)
- feat(library): remember list and type, add genre, year and watched filters (#2681) @skoruppa
- fix(player): bottom controls pushed up on Android with gesture navigation (#2680) @skoruppa
- fix(debrid): match TorBox alternative-hash cache answers (#2679) @WhiteGiso
- i18n: use a regular space before the seconds unit (#2674) @SK-Gits
- feat(subtitles): add outline width and match the styled overlay to native renderers (#2669) @skoruppa
- i18n: add complete high-fidelity Brazilian Portuguese localization (#2668) @jhojhocraazy
- feat(l10n): add Ukrainian localization (#2665) @insabon
- feat(addons): support Stremio player and library tracking addons (#2660) @skoruppa
- fix(player): fall back from the next episode's auto-selected source (#2653) @skoruppa
- fix(ios): keep downloads out of iCloud and computer backups (#2650) @vgyy4
- i18n(he): update latest Hebrew strings (#2631) @haveAnIssue
- fix(ui): correct mixed RTL/LTR text in Search and Watch Party (#2563) @i7xre
- Add Simplified Chinese (zh) localization (#2499) @JadeDouble
- i18n(ur): translate new episode-shuffle resources (#2090) @muzii9
